result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mostly around missing/unclear UI elements and content being clipped at the screen edges.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right appears blank except for a small red dot. It looks like an icon/avatar/notification button failed to load or is missing.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended icon inside the circle, or remove the empty circular button if it is not needed. Ensure the notification dot is anchored to a recognizable control.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrolling sections are clipped at the right edge, including the category chips and the restaurant cards in “Fastest near you.” This may be intentional carousel behavior, but it visually looks abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance, consistent side padding, or snap alignment so partially visible items feel intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card appears to run underneath the fixed bottom navigation area, making the content feel partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so the last visible cards are not hidden behind the bottom navigation.
